lawyer: Abdus Salam and Mahfuzur Rahman ------ For the Petitioners.
parties:
Abdul Motaleb and ors ------ Petitioners. 
Vs.
The State ------ Opposite Party.
full_judgment: "In the present ease, if the High Court had taken the trouble of scrutinizing with care the decisions of this Court in the cases of Khalid Saigon Vs. The State (1962) 14 DLR F.C. 321 P.L.D. 1962 SC 495, Nadira Vs. Jamiat Khan (1968) 20 DLR SC 295 PLD 1968 SC 310 and Md. Shafiq Vs. Md. Hanif and another (1970 S.C.M.R. 143), it would have noticed that principles followed by the Sessions Judge were those laid down in these cases."
